fuel_cost.basis: Fuel arithmetic for /gas. Heat rates are EIA's 2024 average tested full-load heat rates for natural-gas units by prime mover (Electric Power Annual Table 8.2, weighted by net summer capacity); real units run hotter at part load, so fuel figures here are a floor, not a bill. Heat content converts MMBtu to cubic feet.

ai_gas_deals.generation_basis: Gas-fired generation MW behind each gas-tagged deal in config/power_deals.json. A deal's MW can be contracted load or a resource bundle, so the burn arithmetic uses only the gas plant's own stated nameplate, quoted from the deal's evidence file; null where the source does not split it out (then no burn is computed for that deal).
